title: Concurrent RMW lock stress intermittently reports unsafe owner metadata
observation: On 2026-09-23, Node 22 release PR CI for v1.41.4 failed the existing six-process stale .rmw-lock stress smoke test. One writer threw from storeArtifactPath while reading .hunch/edges/.rmw-lock/owner.tmp.json through readRmwOwner. The exact path check that failed was not logged; no hostile artifact or root cause was demonstrated. The same commit passed Node 24, and Node 22 passed on attempt 2. The lock code documents a release/re-acquire window that can turn a retry into an error; this is a candidate to test, not a conclusion. Issue #293 remains open.
